target_contract.prediction_point: after at least one trusted command-derived behavior observation
target_contract.horizon: until the next distinct trusted behavior phase or session termination
target_contract.tactic_target_semantics: unordered set of trusted ATT&CK tactics attached to the next distinct command-derived behavior phase

required_fields.forecast_id: stable identifier derived from model, input, and prediction timestamp
required_fields.observation_timestamp: time at which the input evidence was frozen
required_fields.status_reason: stable non-sensitive reason code and human-readable text

model.code_commit: source commit used to build the artifact

input.preprocessing_sha256: hash of the complete preprocessing contract
input.vocabulary_sha256: hash of ordered tactic, technique, and terminal vocabularies
input.input_hash: hash of the redacted canonical input

baseline.model_id: hard-backoff VOMM rebuilt for the same target contract

compatibility.storage: store v3 as a new immutable payload schema in prediction_snapshots or a dedicated forecast table; never rewrite v1/v2 rows
compatibility.api: dual-read v1/v2/v3; expose explicit schema and target semantics; retain existing historical fields unchanged
compatibility.reports: attach only under model_prediction/next_tactic_forecast with statistical_prediction_not_observed_evidence semantics
compatibility.dashboard: label raw scores, terminal outcome, abstention, baseline, and disagreement; do not show raw score as confidence percentage
compatibility.historical_records: point-in-time stored snapshot remains authoritative for historical presentation
compatibility.reevaluation: must create a new linked record explicitly labeled current-policy/model reevaluation

fail_closed_conditions: checkpoint, artifact, manifest, preprocessing, or vocabulary hash mismatch
unsupported or out-of-distribution input under the frozen coverage policy
